# file.copy

Copy files with checksum verification and atomic writes

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `backup` | boolean | No | - |
| `checksum` | string | No | - |
| `dest` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `follow_symlinks` | boolean | No | - |
| `force` | boolean | No | - |
| `group` | string | No | - |
| `mode` | string | No | - |
| `owner` | string | No | - |
| `src` | string | **Yes** | - |

## Examples

```yaml
# Copy a config file with explicit mode + owner
- name: Drop the systemd unit
  file.copy:
    src: ./files/myapp.service
    dest: /etc/systemd/system/myapp.service
    mode: "0644"
    owner: root
    group: root
  become: true
```

## Platform Support

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd

## Events Emitted

- `file.copied`
